posts.zh:
dsh-dingtalk-channel 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0b98a1fa792d99a3df07.html
posts.en:
dsh-dingtalk-channel is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0b98a1fa792d99a3df07.html
